subject: Request: Attestation re: model derivation & customer data — MediHealth
messages:
From: Laurence King <laurence.king@medihealth.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: privacy@medihealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Attestation re: model derivation & customer data — MediHealth

Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — MediHealth is running a narrow DP/PHI workflow and we need a written attestation regarding how Redwood handles customer prompts and generated responses. Specifically: 

1) Do you ever use customer prompts or model outputs (responses) to train or fine-tune shared/open models, or any internal model variants that could be exposed to other customers?
2) For your Hosted API, what is the retention window for prompt/response logs, and what automated processes ingest logs for model improvements or safety?
3) For Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments, can you confirm whether any telemetry or logs are used for model training or derivation, even in aggregated/anonymized form?
4) We require evidence (SOC2 report reference / SIG answer / DPIA excerpt) that customer data will not be used to derive models absent explicit contractual consent. If possible, provide draft language we can include in our DPA appendix.

We are working under an expedited privacy review timeline; can you send a short attestation and any supporting artifacts by COB Friday? Also attaching the SIG questionnaire items that triggered this.

Regards,
Laurence King
Data Protection Officer, MediHealth
laurence.king@medihealth.com
Attachment: MediHealth-SIG-Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Attestation re: model derivation & customer data — MediHealth

Marcus / Vivek — draft attached. I kept the attestation succinct and included references to our default retention and opt-in model. Key points: 

- Hosted API: by default, customer prompts and generated responses are retained in encrypted logs for up to 30 days for abuse detection, rate limiting, and billing reconciliation. We do not use Hosted API customer prompts/responses to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve our shared or publicly-accessible models unless a customer has explicitly opted-in via a contractual amendment or product opt-in flow.

- Dedicated: for customers on Redwood Dedicated (reserved pools), telemetry that contains customer payloads is not used to train any Redwood-managed model. Customers can enable optional telemetry / metrics sharing; such settings are opt-in and covered by contract.

- Private (VPC / on-prem): Redwood Private customers retain full control of data. Redwood does not access customer prompt/response data for training or model development in Private deployments unless customer expressly configures a managed-upload or consents contractually.

- Evidence & Controls: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report under NDA, SIG Lite answers, the DPIA excerpt showing data flows, and our standard DPA language for "no-derive" clauses. See Drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-MediHealth-DPIA

I attached a plain-text attestation you can send as-is; I also added two short bullets for the DPA appendix. Let me know if we need legal to sign or if they want a standard corporate stamp.

Rachel Kim
Privacy & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: attestation-draft.txt (txt)

From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laurence King <laurence.king@medihealth.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Attestation re: model derivation & customer data — MediHealth

Laurence — thanks for the clear prompts. Please find below a short attestation and references; Rachel drafted the language and I have included links to the artifacts you requested. We're happy to execute contract language if MediHealth would like a signed DPA appendix.

-- Attestation (for MediHealth) --
Redwood Inference attests that, unless expressly agreed in writing, we do not use customer-supplied prompts or model outputs (responses) to train, fine-tune, or derive models that are shared or made available to other Redwood customers. For Hosted API customers the default log retention window is 30 days; logs are used only for abuse prevention, billing, and service reliability. Any use of customer data for model improvements requires explicit customer opt-in documented in contract or product opt-in flows. For Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private deployments, telemetry or payloads that contain customer prompts/responses are not used for training by Redwood.

Supporting artifacts:
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — available under NDA (contact security@redwoodinference.com)
- SIG / CAIQ answers — selected items attached and full SIG responses available on request
- DPIA excerpt & dataflow diagram — https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-MediHealth-DPIA
- Suggested DPA clause (no-derive model clause) — attached as draft

If this wording works, we can provide a signed attestation on company letterhead and the SOC 2 package under NDA. Please advise whether MediHealth would like a legal sign-off or if this attestation plus referenced artifacts satisfies your privacy committee.

Best,
Marcus Lin
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Redwood-Security-Pack.zip (zip)
